## About this project

- There is an appetite to have consistent content given to new EHS hires to accelerate their learning curve and hit the ground running.
- I believe the same concept can be applied for EHS resources in general.
- Some work on this front has already been done:
    - ~75% on a New Hire Resources [MS Loop Page](https://loop.microsoft.)
    - Existing [SharePoint templates for Onboarding New Hires](https://stackinfrastructure.sharepoint.com.mcas.ms/sites/OnboardEmployeesTest) (would just need to make specific for new EHS Hires).
